_about: Skills the Warden can learn from a trainer for coins. `teaches`: abilities that appear in the spellbook once learned. `maxRank`: skills that improve with use (fishing rises with each catch, cooking with each dish that is not yet easy for you).

skills.name: Camping
skills.desc: Pitch a camp anywhere quiet. Your spirit rises there if you fall, and resting by it builds rested experience.

skills.name: Fishing
skills.desc: Cast a line into still water and strike when the bob dips. Rises with every catch.

skills.name: Lockpicking
skills.desc: Open locked chests without their key (you need lockpicks). Each lock needs a certain rank; every lock you pick raises it.

skills.name: Cooking
skills.desc: Cook fish and meat at a fire (a camp or the inn's hearth). Grilled perch and roast dace come with the skill; Hester teaches more as you improve. Rises as you cook.

skills.name: Skinning
skills.desc: Skin the beasts you kill for their hides and pelts (you need a skinning knife). Loot the body first, then skin it. Higher-level beasts need a higher rank (5 ranks a level); the skill rises with every skin that is not yet easy for you.
